title: Middle-Aged Leaving First-Tier Cities
synopsis: Some middle-aged people choose to leave the large 1-tier cities for a simpler life in smaller cities

fullText.simplified:
中年人逃离北上广

    这些年来，逃离北上广一直是中国年轻人们热议的话题。因为房价居高不下，生活的压力让许多年轻人被迫离开一线城市。事实上，逃离北上广的不仅仅是买不起房的年轻人，还有一些成家立业、有房有车的中年夫妻。
    为了逃离繁重的工作、焦虑的生活和糟糕的环境，有些人卖了北京或者上海的房子，成了“百万富翁”。他们带着几百上千万，怀着对美好生活的向往，搬到小城市生活。他们在当地买房子，给孩子存一笔钱作为教育基金，自己仍然能够留一笔钱作为养老金。安排好这一切，他们便觉得从此没有什么后顾之忧了，开始每天喝茶、会友、养生的闲散生活。
    他们之中，有的人享受着新的生活方式，觉得自己终于卸下了沉重的负担，获得了自由。而有的人在一段时间以后却意识到，这样的生活过久了，和以前繁忙焦虑的生活一样令人厌倦。
fullText.traditional:
中年人逃離北上廣

    這些年來，逃離北上廣一直是中國年輕人們熱議的話題。因為房價居高不下，生活的壓力讓許多年輕人被迫離開一線城市。事實上，逃離北上廣的不僅僅是買不起房的年輕人，還有一些成家立業、有房有車的中年夫妻。
    為了逃離繁重的工作、焦慮的生活和糟糕的環境，有些人賣了北京或者上海的房子，成了“百萬富翁”。他們帶著幾百上千萬，懷著對美好生活的嚮往，搬到小城市生活。他們在當地買房子，給孩子存一筆錢作為教育基金，自己仍然能夠留一筆錢作為養老金。安排好這一切，他們便覺得從此沒有什麼後顧之憂了，開始每天喝茶、會友、養生的閑散生活。
    他們之中，有的人享受著新的生活方式，覺得自己終於卸下了沉重的負擔，獲得了自由。而有的人在一段時間以後卻意識到，這樣的生活過久了，和以前繁忙焦慮的生活一樣令人厭倦。

sentences.traditional: 這些年來，逃離北上廣一直是中國年輕人們熱議的話題。

sentences.traditional: 因為房價居高不下，生活的壓力讓許多年輕人被迫離開一線城市。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi fáng jià jū gāo bú xià shēng huó de yā lì ràng xǔ duō nián qīng rén bèi pò lí kāi yí xiàn chéng shì
sentences.english: Over the last few years, discussions about leaving Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou have been a popular topic among young people in China.

sentences.simplified: 事实上，逃离北上广的不仅仅是买不起房的年轻人，
sentences.traditional: 事實上，逃離北上廣的不僅僅是買不起房的年輕人，
sentences.pinyin: shì shí shang táo lí běi shàng guǎng de bù jǐn jǐn shì mǎi bù qǐ fáng de nián qīng rén
sentences.english: Because of real-estate prices and high pressure, many young people have been forced to leave the first-tier cities.

sentences.simplified: 还有一些成家立业、有房有车的中年夫妻。
sentences.traditional: 還有一些成家立業、有房有車的中年夫妻。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yì xiē chéng jiā lì yè yǒu fáng yǒu chē de zhōng nián fū qī
sentences.english: In fact, it’s not only young people leaving.
Married middle-aged couples with good jobs, apartments and cars also tend to be leaving the cities.

sentences.simplified: 为了逃离繁重的工作、焦虑的生活和糟糕的环境，
sentences.traditional: 為了逃離繁重的工作、焦慮的生活和糟糕的環境，

sentences.simplified: 有些人卖了北京或者上海的房子，成了“百万富翁”。
sentences.traditional: 有些人賣了北京或者上海的房子，成了“百萬富翁”。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē rén mài le běi jīng huò zhě shàng hǎi de fáng zi chéng le bǎi wàn fù wēng
sentences.english: In order to escape from stressed work, anxious life and bad environment ..

sentences.simplified: 他们带着几百上千万，怀着对美好生活的向往，搬到小城市生活。
sentences.traditional: 他們帶著幾百上千萬，懷著對美好生活的嚮往，搬到小城市生活。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dài zhe jǐ bǎi shàng qiān wàn huái zhe duì měi hǎo shēng huó de xiàng wǎng bān dào xiǎo chéng shì shēng huó
sentences.english: ..  some therefore sell their homes in Beijing or Shanghai, often becoming millionaires by doing so.

sentences.traditional: 他們在當地買房子，給孩子存一筆錢作為教育基金，自己仍然能夠留一筆錢作為養老金。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zài dāng dì mǎi fáng zi gěi hái zi cún yì bǐ qián zuò wéi jiào yù jī jīn zì jǐ réng rán néng gòu liú yì bǐ qián zuò wéi yǎng lǎo jīn
sentences.english: They instead move to smaller cities with millions of yuan and a desire of a better life.

sentences.simplified: 安排好这一切，他们便觉得从此没有什么后顾之忧了，
sentences.traditional: 安排好這一切，他們便覺得從此沒有什麼後顧之憂了，
sentences.pinyin: ān pái hǎo zhè yí qiè tā men biàn jué de cóng cǐ méi yǒu shén me hòu gù zhī yōu le
sentences.english: They are able to afford a house, education funds for their kids and still have enough left for a good pension.

sentences.simplified: 开始每天喝茶、会友、养生的闲散生活。
sentences.traditional: 開始每天喝茶、會友、養生的閑散生活。
sentences.pinyin: kāi shǐ měi tiān hē chá huì yǒu yǎng shēng de xián sǎn shēng huó
sentences.english: With all their responsibilities taken care of they then often feel like there won’t be anything more to worry about.
They are able to start living a leisurely life consisting of drinking tea, meeting friends and paying attention to their health.

sentences.simplified: 他们之中，有的人享受着新的生活方式，觉得自己终于卸下了沉重的负担，获得了自由。
sentences.traditional: 他們之中，有的人享受著新的生活方式，覺得自己終於卸下了沉重的負擔，獲得了自由。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhī zhōng yǒu de rén xiǎng shòu zhe xīn de shēng huó fāng shì jué de zì jǐ zhōng yú xiè xià le chén zhòng de fù dān huò dé le zì yóu

sentences.simplified: 而有的人在一段时间以后却意识到，这样的生活过久了，和以前繁忙焦虑的生活一样令人厌倦。
sentences.traditional: 而有的人在一段時間以後卻意識到，這樣的生活過久了，和以前繁忙焦慮的生活一樣令人厭倦。
sentences.pinyin: ér yǒu de rén zài yí duàn shí jiān yǐ hòu què yì shí dào zhè yàng de shēng huó guò jiǔ le hé yǐ qián fán máng jiāo lǜ de shēng huó yí yàng lìng rén yàn juàn
sentences.english: However, while some will keep on relishing their new lifestyle, believing it to completely unburden them and providing total freedom, ..
.. others will after a period of time find their new life to be equally tiresome and stressful as life back in the city.

sentence_translations: Over the last few years, discussions about leaving Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou have been a popular topic among young people in China.
Because of real-estate prices and high pressure, many young people have been forced to leave the first-tier cities.
In fact, it’s not only young people leaving.
Married middle-aged couples with good jobs, apartments and cars also tend to be leaving the cities.
In order to escape from stressed work, anxious life and bad environment ..
..  some therefore sell their homes in Beijing or Shanghai, often becoming millionaires by doing so.
They instead move to smaller cities with millions of yuan and a desire of a better life.
They are able to afford a house, education funds for their kids and still have enough left for a good pension.
With all their responsibilities taken care of they then often feel like there won’t be anything more to worry about.
They are able to start living a leisurely life consisting of drinking tea, meeting friends and paying attention to their health.
However, while some will keep on relishing their new lifestyle, believing it to completely unburden them and providing total freedom, ..
.. others will after a period of time find their new life to be equally tiresome and stressful as life back in the city.
